name: Textarea
purpose: Lets users enter multi-line free-form text.
neverUseFor: Option selection - use Select, RadioGroup, or CheckboxGroup
rationale: Textarea wraps a native <textarea> with a 32px min-height floor (semantic.size.m) instead of a height ladder, because its height is driven by rows. `size` only changes font size, keeping it aligned with Input and Select in the same form.

mayExtendLocally: Choose rows, label, placeholder and helper text
Add validation and character counts through the documented props
mustEscalateToDS: Adding a fixed height ladder or new sizes
Changing border, focus-ring or error tokens

authored.name: required
authored.description: The field must have a value before form submission.

anatomy.description: Layout wrapper for label, field, and messages.

Accessible label. Always rendered - visible or sr-only. Sits exactly 8px above the field — see .ai/maps/patterns/form-field-spacing.md. Disabled: dims to text.disabled with the rest of the text (.ai/maps/patterns/disabled-state.md).

The required indicator (*) inside the label, the label color, 2px (spacing/3xs) after the text — shown by `required`. Disabled: dims to text.disabled with the rest of the text (.ai/maps/patterns/disabled-state.md).
Field shell around the native textarea.
Helper text below the field. Sits exactly 8px below it — see .ai/maps/patterns/form-field-spacing.md. Disabled: dims to text.disabled with the rest of the text (.ai/maps/patterns/disabled-state.md).

props.name: label
props.description: Visible or screen-reader-only label. Required for a11y.

props.name: description
props.description: Helper text shown below the field.

props.name: hideLabel
props.description: Hides the label visually but keeps it accessible.

props.name: size
props.description: Field size. Uses the shared field scale for density and typography.

props.name: showCount
props.description: Shows a live character counter when maxLength is set.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Value change handler. Also drives the live character counter.

height.note: component.textarea.height aliases semantic.size.m (32px) and is applied as min-height on textarea-field — a floor, not a per-size ladder like Input/Select. `size` itself only changes font-size (s: --helix-primitive-fontSize-s, m: base/default, l: --helix-primitive-fontSize-m); the visible height above the floor is controlled by the native `rows` attribute and `resize`.

modes.hug: Width shrinks to content or container constraints.
modes.fixed: Explicit width set by the consumer.

motion: CSS transitions/animations: neutralised by the global prefers-reduced-motion rule

properties.name: state
properties.description: Figma-only axis: hover/focus are CSS pseudo-classes in code. invalid,   disabled and the secondary toggles are their own variants (contracts/figma-conversion.json,   pattern form-field).

value.reason: the text in the field: without it a designer can only draw an empty field (owner-approved exception)

figma.structure: textarea-root (8px gap) > textarea-label (text + textarea-required),  textarea-wrapper as wide as code default 20 native columns (173 / 194 / 241px for s / m / l; fullWidth drawn at 480px,  filling its container),  textarea-field 4 rows tall = code default rows,  textarea-counter and the native resize handle anchored bottom-right,  textarea-description,  textarea-error. The native resize handle is drawn by the browser (no data-helix-part); its layer is named native resize handle and hides with resize=none.
figma.variantCombinations: 26 variants (2026-10-20): size s/m/l × invalid × state default/hover/focus = 18,   disabled per size = 3,   and hideLabel / fullWidth / resize none / horizontal / both once each at size m,   default,   valid,   enabled = 5 (the standard rules). Invalid focus keeps the red border with a 20% red ring.
